segments.en: In today's episode we interview Mercedes Riveira, physicist and biomedic, who will talk to us about Data Anonymization in the healthcare sector. He has not told about his professional career, European research project, the role of AI and ML in Medical Physics and his vision of AI in the coming years in Medicine. To learn this and much more, do not hesitate to listen to it in its entirety.

segments.source: Mercedes Riveira explica el papel de la anonimización de datos en la investigación sanitaria. Hablamos de su trayectoria, de la física médica, de proyectos europeos de investigación y de los retos de aplicar IA a la medicina. Una conversación sobre aprender, investigar y proteger los datos con los que trabajamos.
segments.en: Mercedes Riveira explains the role of data anonymisation in healthcare research. We discuss her career, medical physics, European research projects and the challenges of applying AI to medicine. A conversation about learning, research and protecting the data we work with.
